why: Erdős's conjecture that the maximum number of unit distances among n points is n^{1+o(1)} was reportedly disproved in May 2026, first by an OpenAI internal model (inexplicit exponent), then with an explicit exponent by Sawin (n^1.014114), followed by further improvements (Tseng ~1.0316, Naslund >1.036).
